title: Sensor window · Sat 17 Oct 2026 16:00–16:15 · rover-01
content:
Field sensor readings from rover-01 on Saturday 17 October 2026, 16:00–16:15 (afternoon, farm time).
- Air temperature: average 32.8°C (min 32.1°C, max 33.5°C, 15 readings) — hot: heat stress possible, especially with low soil moisture.
- Relative humidity: average 49% (min 45%, max 52%, 15 readings) — moderate: comfortable for most crops.
- Soil moisture: average 39.2% (min 38.4%, max 40.0%, 10 readings) — adequate: suitable for most crops.
- MQ5 gas index (LPG / natural gas / methane): average 210 ADC (min 180 ADC, max 240 ADC, 15 readings) — baseline: no unusual methane or natural-gas signal.
- MQ6 gas index (LPG / butane / propane): average 188 ADC (min 167 ADC, max 216 ADC, 15 readings) — baseline: no unusual LPG signal.
